subject: DIVIDE statement
notes: LANDED (kb/Work PB129, PB3975): identifier-4 stores only if the size error condition is not raised - gated on the statement flag under a SIZE ERROR phrase (ON or NOT, PB3989) or EC-SIZE checking, so the quotient's size error leaves the remainder unchanged. With checking off and no phrase the condition is 14.6.13.1.3 item 8's and DOC-A.1-70 follows GnuCOBOL 3.2: the remainder is stored, formed from the quotient truncated at identifier-3's scale with every integer digit (no digit cap: the PB129 cap, CobolNum.CapDigits, is deleted - 6 c)'s digit count governs only a quotient that raised no size error, which fits identifier-3). The back-multiply rides Combine (MulChecked under checking, the Dec lane under a standard mode) instead of a raw Int128 splice that wrapped silently.
